lines: You'll never love me again
You'll never need me again
And so I
Am all alone like this
What did you say back then?
Words that never reached me drift through the air
Even though I know
Today I go and wish again
For things that can never come true
Don't let go — hold on tight
Hold my hand
You said we'd go on together, the two of us
The hand I held in yours was warm
And gentle
You always did this to me —
Made me angry, then made me cry in the end
But afterward you'd say you were sorry
I loved that face of yours, ah
Don't let go — hold on tight
Yes, with all my strength
I want to stay in your arms
The two of us
Foreheads touching
As we fall asleep
Did you know we'd never meet again?
Don't let go — hold on tight
I love you
You won't even smile for me one more time
Before your
Warmth fades away
Hold me
